processing: Decoded using afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16 source.mp3 decoded.wav. First three outputs retained exact original Python sample-rounding normalization from build_settlement_ambience.py conventions. Remaining seven use Python 3.9 audioop.rms/max native PCM measurements and audioop.mul signed16 truncating constant gain min(-42-sourceRmsDbfs,-3-sourcePeakDbfs); original WAV parameters retained. No compression, added sound, resampling or crossfade. RMS measurements use integer audioop.rms, so quantization slightly changes reported precision.
review: Technical checks only; no agent listening or sponsor acceptance. Boundary step is not evidence of inaudible seam. Audition consecutive loops for phantom words, density, hooks, hiss and fatigue.
